name: OPEN Program (take IU Bloomington classes while in high school)
what_you_do: Qualified local juniors and seniors can take IU Bloomington courses. You earn college credit. You can take them during the school year or in summer. Spots depend on space available.
who_can_apply: High school juniors or seniors with a GPA of at least 3.0, recommended by a principal or guidance counselor, living with a parent or guardian within commuting distance of campus. IU GPA of at least 2.5 is also required once enrolled.
pay_detail: Students pay the regular IU undergraduate credit-hour and mandatory fees (student health fee waived). Dollar amounts are not stated on the program page.
duration: One or more courses per term (fall, spring or summer)
deadline_text: Applications accepted about three months before to two weeks before each semester starts. No late applications.
how_to_apply: Talk to your high school counselor, then email openprgm@iu.edu for the form and instructions.
notes: Only for students who live close enough to commute to Bloomington. Costs are real college credit fees. Not a job.
